text:
Maria: Heads-up — Orcasys renewal ~6 weeks out. Noticed a sharp drop in usage across embeddings + reranker flows. ML lead (Priya) left last month and they've kicked off a short pilot with RivalA. Need a quick triage and salvage playbook. :warning:

Jake: Oof. What's the magnitude and which teams are impacted? Procurement timeline?

Maria: Usage numbers: 30d token-equivalent calls down ~70%. Active seats from 150 -> 45 in 30d. Most traffic concentrated in their "eng-team" workspace. Renewal target: 2026-05-15. Champion was Priya (ML). Procurement contact is Sam (Finance).

Ana: Can you share the aggregation we ran? Want to check the top users + recent failing requests.

Maria: Pasted the query we used:

```sql
SELECT workspace_id, SUM(api_calls_30d) AS calls_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer = 'orcasys'
GROUP BY workspace_id
ORDER BY calls_30d DESC;
```

Result: eng-team = 81% of calls. Secondary workspaces nearly idle. Drop correlates with Priya exit + last month deploy.

Dylan: Any unpaid invoices or contract levers? Are they on committed capacity?

Maria: They're on a monthly committed plan with auto-renew. No overdue invoices. Sam is consolidating vendors this quarter. RivalA pilot is a 2-week evaluation that started last week.

Ana: Suggest two initial plays: 1) Offer a 30m technical onboarding session for whoever replaced Priya — focused on quick wins (latency, cost, reranker fidelity). I'll lead office hours next Tue. 2) Provide a 10-business-day rollback-safe PoC for their critical reranker path with clear KPIs (median latency, cost per 1k queries, accuracy delta).

Jake: I'll re-engage Sam and ask for the new ML lead intro. Plan to send a health-check note today and put Ana's office hours on the table.

Maria: Draft outreach below — please edit:

"Hi Sam — we noticed recent activity changes and wanted to check in ahead of your May renewal. Would you be open to a 30-minute technical review with our infra & solutions team to map a low-risk PoC and share a concise usage health snapshot? Available slots: Wed 11am, Thu 3pm. Also happy to tailor to whoever's covering ML now."

Ana: LGTM. Add a line asking if there are specific areas RivalA is testing (latency, price, model quality). That helps us scope the PoC.

ops-bot: [intel-alert] RivalA pilot detected for Orcasys (source: partner_channel). Confidence: medium. ts=3765555000.

Dylan: I'll prepare a one-pager for procurement summarizing differences: SLA options, dedicated capacity, cost/runbook, and rollout support. Keep it short for Sam.

Maria: Request: enable 30d telemetry retention for a focused reranker latency cohort and run a 7-day latency comparison. If we can demonstrate median <30ms vs RivalA numbers, that will be compelling.

Ana: I'll add a latency dashboard and baseline cohort analysis. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Jake: Outreach sent to Sam. Marking this high-touch. Assigning owners: Ana = tech deep-dive + PoC scope, Dylan = procurement one-pager, Maria = account outreach & renewal tracker. I'll run weekly checks until renewal is closed. :thumbsup:

Maria: Thanks all. Priorities: confirm successor to Priya, schedule technical convo, and land a quick PoC. Post calendar link here when scheduled.

Jake: Sam replied — prefers Wed 11am or Fri 9am. I booked Wed 11am provisional. sharing invite after Sam accepts. :eyes:
